decisions.decision: Deployment-limit claims must be challenged against repo truth, not left at assumption level
When the agent says a capability is unavailable, Michael expects a direct repo audit to verify that claim

corrections.root_cause: Premature capability denial without evidence gathering

principles.name: Repo Truth Outranks Assumption
principles.interpretation: If a claimed limitation might be contradicted by repository state, search the repo first before reporting the limitation

principles.name: Challenge the Blind Spot Immediately
principles.interpretation: When capability doubt appears, audit the reachable estate before closing the question

system_design_insights.insight: A deployment block is not fully proven until the reachable repo has been searched for live workflows, deploy commands, and hidden control paths
Repo audit acts as the integrity check between tool limitation claims and actual execution surface

cross_references.note: This session is the GENESIS of L08 — born from this exact frustration
Repo search as verification layer for capability claims
Silent capability denial is as bad as silent success — verify explicitly
